# The part of logex that the page describes

This page is for a contributor. Say in 1 sentence which part of logex the page
describes, and what the reader can change after it.

Copy this file to `docs/architecture/`, `docs/implementation/` or `docs/contributing/`,
give it a name and add its line to `docs/pages.exs`. Then replace each paragraph.

## What the part does

Describe the job of the part and the data that goes in and out. Add a diagram of 12 nodes
or fewer, with a caption.

## How it is built

Name each module and say what it holds. Link to a module with its name in a code span.

## Why it is built this way

Give the reasons. A contributor page can cite a decision of `docs/organisation.md` by
its number.

## How to change it

1. Give the steps of a frequent change.
2. Name the test that fails if the change is wrong.

## See also

- Link to the decision records for this part.
- Link to the related pages.
